sec.title: August 27 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 239)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 27** across American network radio and syndication, African safari adventure on *Stand By for Adventure*, veteran rehabilitation on *Treasury Salute*, Richard Kollmar in *Boston Blackie*, dramatic soprano Marjorie Lawrence on *The Bell Telephone Hour*, Elaine Carrington's *Pepper Young's Family* for Camay Soap, and E.G. Marshall hosting Robert Louis Stevenson's supernatural classic *The Bottle Imp* on *CBS Radio Mystery Theater* (1945–1998):
